domains.name: User Authentication Testing
domains.description: Testing user login functionality including valid and invalid credential scenarios
domains.purpose: Validate that the SauceDemo application correctly handles user authentication attempts

domains.name: Test Data Management
domains.description: Unified system for reading and managing test data from multiple file formats
domains.purpose: Provide a centralized interface for accessing test data from JSON, CSV, and Excel sources

domains.name: Page Object Abstraction
domains.description: Encapsulation of UI selectors and page interactions following the Page Object Model pattern
domains.purpose: Separate test logic from UI implementation details and improve test maintainability

domains.name: Test Infrastructure & Execution
domains.description: Multi-browser test execution framework and test orchestration
domains.purpose: Execute tests across multiple browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari) and manage test lifecycle

businessFlows.name: Login Success Flow (Happy Path)
businessFlows.description: User successfully authenticates with valid credentials and gains access to the application
businessFlows.successCriteria: User is redirected to inventory.html and can access application features

businessFlows.name: Login Failure Flow (Sad Path)
businessFlows.description: User authentication fails due to invalid credentials or locked account
businessFlows.successCriteria: Error message is displayed and user remains on login page

businessFlows.name: Test Data Pipeline
businessFlows.description: Load, parse, and deliver test data to test cases from multiple source formats
businessFlows.successCriteria: Data is correctly parsed regardless of source format and available to tests

businessFlows.name: Multi-Browser Test Execution
businessFlows.description: Execute test suites across multiple browser contexts sequentially
businessFlows.successCriteria: All tests execute successfully in each browser and results are aggregated

processSteps.name: Navigate to Login Page
processSteps.description: Open the SauceDemo login page in the browser
processSteps.errorHandling: Timeout or network error leads to test failure

processSteps.name: Enter Valid Username
processSteps.description: Fill the username field with valid credentials
processSteps.errorHandling: Element not found or interaction timeout

processSteps.name: Enter Valid Password
processSteps.description: Fill the password field with valid credentials
processSteps.errorHandling: Element not found or interaction timeout

processSteps.name: Enter Invalid Username
processSteps.description: Fill the username field with invalid/locked account credentials
processSteps.errorHandling: Element not found or interaction timeout

processSteps.name: Enter Invalid Password
processSteps.description: Fill the password field with invalid credentials
processSteps.errorHandling: Element not found or interaction timeout

processSteps.name: Click Login Button
processSteps.description: Submit the login form by clicking the login button
processSteps.errorHandling: Button not clickable or not found

processSteps.name: Verify Successful Navigation to Inventory
processSteps.description: Confirm user is redirected to inventory page after successful login
processSteps.errorHandling: URL mismatch indicates authentication failure

processSteps.name: Verify Error Message Displayed
processSteps.description: Confirm error message is visible after failed login attempt
processSteps.errorHandling: Error message not visible indicates application issue

processSteps.name: Identify Data Source Format
processSteps.description: Determine file type based on file extension
processSteps.errorHandling: Unsupported file type throws error

processSteps.name: Load JSON Test Data
processSteps.description: Read and parse JSON test data file
processSteps.errorHandling: File not found or invalid JSON structure

processSteps.name: Load CSV Test Data
processSteps.description: Read and parse CSV test data file
processSteps.errorHandling: File not found or malformed CSV

processSteps.name: Load Excel Test Data
processSteps.description: Read and parse Excel workbook sheet
processSteps.errorHandling: Sheet not found or file corruption

processSteps.name: Parse and Transform Data
processSteps.description: Convert raw file data into structured credential objects
processSteps.implementation: Map parsed data to LoginData type structure
processSteps.errorHandling: Missing required fields or type mismatch

processSteps.name: Return Parsed Test Data
processSteps.description: Make parsed data available to test case
processSteps.errorHandling: Data injection failure into test

processSteps.name: Initialize Browser Instance
processSteps.description: Create browser context for test execution
processSteps.errorHandling: Browser launch failure prevents test execution

processSteps.name: Create Browser Context
processSteps.description: Establish isolated browser context for test
processSteps.implementation: Create new browser context with default options
processSteps.errorHandling: Context creation timeout

processSteps.name: Create Page Instance
processSteps.description: Create new page within browser context
processSteps.errorHandling: Page creation timeout

processSteps.name: Execute Test Suite
processSteps.description: Run all test cases in the test file
processSteps.implementation: Execute test('valid login test') and test('invalid login test')
processSteps.errorHandling: Test failure, timeout, or assertion error

processSteps.name: Close Browser Context
processSteps.description: Clean up and close browser context after tests
processSteps.errorHandling: Graceful cleanup failure

processSteps.name: Generate Test Report
processSteps.description: Aggregate and report test execution results
processSteps.errorHandling: Report generation failure

edges.description: Authentication tests depend on PageObject for UI interaction
Test data flows from data management to authentication tests
Test infrastructure orchestrates execution of all tests
After login submission, verify success by checking URL
After failed login, verify error message display
If file extension is .json, load JSON
If file extension is .csv, load CSV
If file extension is .xlsx, load Excel
Loaded data flows to parsing step
CSV records flow to parsing step
Excel data flows to parsing step
Parsed data is returned to test
Test data credentials injected into login step
Browser initialized before creating context
Context created before page instantiation
Page instance injected into test execution
Context closed after test execution completes
Results gathered and reported after cleanup
Login success flow belongs to authentication domain
Login failure flow belongs to authentication domain
Data pipeline flow belongs to data management domain
Browser execution flow belongs to test infrastructure domain

businessRules.description: Valid credentials must result in redirect to inventory page
Invalid credentials must result in error message display
businessRules.consequence: User remains on login page and cannot proceed

businessRules.description: System must support reading credentials from JSON, CSV, and Excel files
businessRules.consequence: Tests can use data from multiple sources

businessRules.description: All tests must pass across Chrome, Firefox, and Safari browsers

integrationPoints: PageObject pattern integration with test framework
Data pipeline integration with test execution
keyInsights: The project uses Page Object Model to separate UI details from test logic
Test data is flexibly sourced from multiple formats through a unified interface
Both happy path (valid login) and sad path (invalid login) scenarios are tested
The infrastructure supports parallel execution across multiple browsers
